name: Creamy Tuscan Tofu, Spinach & Tomato Sauté with Roasted Potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg new potatoes
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes. Transfer to a large baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place potatoes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring once, until golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a large bowl, sprinkle with cornstarch and salt, then gently toss to coat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Return crispy tofu to the bowl. (Reserve pot for later use.)
While the tofu is cooking, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Return pot to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and tomatoes; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
When the onion and tomato are done, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl, setting aside a small handful for serving.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan.
Add Parmesan, basil, cream, salt, and pepper to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and sauce is combined, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy whipping cream
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return tofu to the pot with the sauce and gently stir to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide creamy tofu sauté and potatoes between plates or bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and enjoy!
